clarification.en: The Swaminathan Commission had a comprehensive mandate covering land reform, credit, irrigation, and C2+50% pricing formula. Ashoke Gulati-led panels often focus specifically on market reforms, fertilizer subsidies, and trade policies.
clarification.hi: The Swaminathan Commission had a comprehensive mandate covering land reform, credit, irrigation, and C2+50% pricing formula. Ashoke Gulati-led panels often focus specifically on market reforms, fertilizer subsidies, and trade policies.

relationship.en: Recommendations of high-level committees often translate into budgetary allocations and policy announcements in the Economic Survey.
